item.title: ‘Your address shouldn’t affect your access’: Peter Paul’s legacy continues in Richmond’s East End
item.description: For more than four decades, Peter Paul Development Center has been a constant in Richmond’s East End — serving generations of families with after-school programming, meals, mentorship and community support.

item.title: Petersburg City Council considering expansion of road nearby new casino
item.description: Petersburg leaders have their minds on expansion for the area around the new Live! Casino, including extending Wagner Road and rezoning the area for redevelopment.

item.title: VCU Health finalizes purchase of Hope Pharmacy in Richmond
item.description: Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU) Health has finalized a purchase agreement with Hope Pharmacy in Richmond.

item.title: Late to court, broke bond rules: Suspects in toddler's death case back behind bars
item.description: All three suspects charged in connection to a toddler's death in Henrico County are back in custody after showing up late to court and not following the rules of their bond.

item.title: 77-year-old woman charged after child hit by car in Colonial Heights
item.description: A 77-year-old Colonial Heights woman is facing charges after police say she hit a child with her car Wednesday morning while they were running to their bus stop.

item.title: House committee passes amended VMI bill, strips language transferring governance to VSU
item.description: Changes could be coming to the Board of Visitors at the Virginia Military Institute (VMI), but those changes might not be as drastic as they once seemed.

item.title: Grassroots and growing: How Richmonders are responding to immigration enforcement
item.description: As the divide over federal immigration enforcement continues across the country, millions of Americans are making their voices heard -- and that includes grassroots efforts right here in Richmond.

item.title: Shop small, earn rewards: New Richmond pilot program incentivizes shopping at local businesses
item.description: Richmond shoppers can earn rewards for shopping at local small businesses through a new pilot program.

item.title: Vicious Biscuit to open first-ever Virginia restaurant in Richmond
item.description: Vicious Biscuit, a fast-casual breakfast restaurant, will open its first-ever Virginia location in Richmond.

item.title: CODI Alert: 13-year-old girl missing out of Goochland may be in danger
item.description: A 13-year-old girl who has been missing out of Goochland County for days may be in danger, per state police.
